snippet.title: NO BACKUP - Official Trailer 2 | Co-Op Bodycam Horror
snippet.description:
NO BACKUP is coming to Steam this month!

You are part of a special ops team. Armed with a bodycam, a weapon, and a radio - you are sent into an abandoned zone.
The mission: get out alive. Together.

But something is hunting you.
Silent. Relentless.

▶ Up to 4-Player Online Co-Op
▶ Immersive Bodycam Perspective
▶ 3 large maps with story-driven missions
▶ Manage resources, coordinate your team, survive

🔴 Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3894440/NO_BACKUP/

📣 Join my Discord: https://discord.gg/2WTsFPEqs6
